title: Channel | Mobile Web | Component Rendering | Responsive Layout | Full Flow |
description:
Customer accesses chatbot via mobile web browser. UI components (flight cards, journey selection, payment forms) must render responsively on smaller screens. Per call transcript: "Validate UI components such as flight cards and seat maps across web, mobile, and WhatsApp channels to ensure consistent display."

Prerequisites:
Channel: Mobile Web (iPhone Safari / Android Chrome); PNR: TCED24; 1 leg AC (YYZ?YVR); Delay 4 hrs; APPR EL-01
